description: This Java source file defines the class JwtTokenVerifier, which is a filter that verifies JWT tokens in HTTP requests, particularly for authentication and token refresh logic within a Spring Security context.

classes.name: JwtTokenVerifier
classes.description: A filter class extending OncePerRequestFilter that intercepts HTTP requests to verify JWT tokens, handle token refresh, and set authentication context.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Overrides the method to intercept each HTTP request, verify JWT tokens, handle token refresh requests, and update the security context.

methods.name: updateResponseWithJwtAndRefreshToken
methods.description: Generates new JWT and refresh tokens, adds the refresh token as a cookie in the response, and adds the JWT to the response headers.

methods.name: getAuthentication
methods.description: Creates an Authentication object from username and authorities extracted from the decoded JWT claims.

methods.name: getJwsClaims
methods.description: Parses and validates a JWT token to extract its claims.

methods.name: readRefreshTokenMapFromRequest
methods.description: Reads and deserializes a JSON payload from the request input stream into a Map containing refresh token data.
